prompt: Your drawing has stopped improving even though you draw the same subjects every day. Which change is most likely to restart your progress?

options.text: Draw the same subjects for even longer each day
Stop drawing completely for six months
Add specific challenges, such as timed studies of hands or shadows, and get feedback on them
Buy more expensive pencils and paper

explanation: A plateau often means practice has become comfortable repetition. Targeting specific weaknesses with new challenges, and getting feedback on them, pushes the exact skills that have stalled.
